item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.8.1

  • Liquid Glass stays glass when you turn Music Mode off: with your icons in macOS's Default or Clear style, the notch is plain see-through glass, like your widgets then, instead of turning black.
  • Settings → General → Notch look is now two buttons, Black and Liquid Glass.
  • Spotify's shuffle and repeat can no longer get stuck behind a permission check that macOS never answers, and Settings → Permissions shows Spotify as Allowed once ShawNotch has reached it.
  • Settings → Permissions can ask for your Downloads folder straight away, without opening the Tray.
